title: Revealing the DAILY ROUTINES of SUCCESSFUL people | Hey Tablo Ep. 21

lines.en: So, I'm looking at the daily routines or morning routines of famous people, and some of these people are just sociopaths.
lines.zh: 我在看名人的每日作息或晨間作息，有些人根本是反社會人格。

lines.en: There's a guy that wakes up at 2:30 a.m. I kid you not.
lines.zh: 有個人凌晨兩點半起床，我沒騙你。

lines.en: Wakes up at 2:30 a.m. to start the day.
lines.zh: 凌晨兩點半起床開始一天。

lines.en: Today, we're looking at daily routines. Hey Tablo, welcome to Hey Tablo.
lines.zh: 今天我們要來看每日作息。Hey Tablo，歡迎收看 Hey Tablo。

lines.en: If you're watching on YouTube, hello. Hello. Hello.
lines.zh: 如果你在 YouTube 上看，哈囉、哈囉、哈囉。

lines.en: If you're listening on any of the podcast platforms where this is available, feel free to continue to listen.
lines.zh: 如果你在任何 podcast 平台上收聽，歡迎繼續聽。

lines.en: But when you get out of the car or get off the treadmill, watch the video cuz it's more fun that way.
lines.zh: 不過等你下車或下了跑步機，去看影片版，因為那樣更好玩。

lines.en: I never imagined this day would come when I am adult enough to say a daily routine is important.
lines.zh: 我從沒想過有一天我會成熟到說出「每日作息很重要」這種話。

lines.en: A morning routine is important.
lines.zh: 晨間作息很重要。

lines.en: But I really do feel that it is important now.
lines.zh: 但我現在真的覺得它很重要。

lines.en: Like if you have some sort of structure or like a basic blueprint of how each day should go, uh it does help you have a more fruitful day.
lines.zh: 如果你有某種架構，或是一天該怎麼過的基本藍圖，呃，真的能幫你過得更有收穫。

lines.en: Uh allows you to finish a lot more things and aim for a better tomorrow.
lines.zh: 呃，讓你完成更多事，朝更好的明天前進。

lines.en: Oh, that sounds so mature.
lines.zh: 喔，聽起來好成熟。

lines.en: But there are certain morning routines and daily routines of famous people that are absolutely insane.
lines.zh: 但有些名人的晨間作息和每日作息真的太瘋狂了。

lines.en: Like I I was saying at the beginning, look at this.
lines.zh: 就像我一開始說的，看看這個。

lines.en: Mark Wahlberg, you know, the actor uh from The Departed, he posted this himself.
lines.zh: 馬克華伯格，你知道，《神鬼無間》那位演員，這是他自己公布的。

lines.en: Typical daily schedule. 2:30 a.m. Wake up. I kid you not.
lines.zh: 典型的一天行程：凌晨 2:30 起床。我沒騙你。

lines.en: Wake up at 2:30 a.m. 2:45 a.m. prayer time. 3:15 a.m. breakfast. 3:40 to 5:15 a.m. workout. 5:30 a.m. postworkout meal. 6:00 am shower.
Okay, most of us haven't even, you know, are we're still like dreaming. 7:30 a.m. golf. 8:00 a.m. snack. 9:30 a.m. cryochamber recovery. 10:30 a.m. snack. 11:00 a.m.
lines.zh: 好，我們大部分人都還在做夢。7:30 打高爾夫，8:00 點心，9:30 冷凍艙恢復，10:30 點心，11:00……

lines.en: Family time meetings, work calls.
lines.zh: 家庭時間、會議、工作電話。

lines.en: I'm assuming his family wakes up at this time. 1:00 p.m. lunch. 2 p.m. meetings, work calls, 3 p.m. pick up kids at school. 3:30 p.m. snack. 4:00 p.m. workout.
lines.zh: 我猜他的家人也是這個時間起床。下午 1:00 午餐，2:00 會議、工作電話，3:00 去學校接小孩，3:30 點心，4:00 第二次健身。

lines.en: Number two, by the way, um there are three schedule uh bullet points here that just say snack.
lines.zh: 順帶一提，呃，這裡有三個行程項目只寫著「點心」。

lines.en: Like he's reminding himself to snack, which is hilarious.
lines.zh: 好像他在提醒自己要吃點心，超好笑。

lines.en: I think yo, it takes him an hour and a half to snack.
lines.zh: 我覺得欸，他吃個點心要花一個半小時。

lines.en: His first snack is happening for an hour and a half from 8 to 9:30.
lines.zh: 他的第一次點心從 8 點吃到 9 點半，吃了一個半小時。

lines.en: And then from 10:30 to 11, he snacks again. That's 30 minutes.
lines.zh: 然後 10:30 到 11 點又吃一次，那是 30 分鐘。

lines.en: And then 30 minutes again at 3:30 p.m.
lines.zh: 下午 3:30 又吃 30 分鐘。

lines.en: That's a total of 2 hours and 30 minutes.
lines.zh: 加起來總共兩個半小時。

lines.en: For a person who's so disciplined, he snacks a long time.
lines.zh: 一個這麼自律的人，吃點心吃這麼久。

lines.en: He golfs for 30 minutes, but snacks for 2.5 hours.
lines.zh: 他打高爾夫 30 分鐘，吃點心卻吃兩個半小時。

lines.en: If you look into the details here, this is not a disciplined person.
lines.zh: 仔細看細節，這根本不是一個自律的人。

lines.en: He spends most of his day snacking. Okay.
lines.zh: 他一天大部分時間都在吃點心。好。

lines.en: Uh so 4:00 p.m. he does a workout number two and then 5:00 p.m. shower.
lines.zh: 呃，所以下午 4:00 他做第二次健身，然後 5:00 洗澡。

lines.en: So he showers twice. 5:30 p.m. dinner family time and 7:30 p.m. bedtime. He goes to sleep.
lines.zh: 所以他洗兩次澡。5:30 晚餐家庭時間，7:30 就寢，去睡了。

lines.en: The time that I used to wake up in my 20s, like when I was just starting music, that's like I would wake up at 7:30 p.m. and he's going to bed at that time and waking up at 2:30 a.m.
lines.zh: 我二十幾歲剛開始做音樂時的起床時間，大概是晚上 7:30，他卻在那個時間睡覺，然後凌晨 2:30 起床。

lines.en: Okay, here's the thing though. This guy's not lying.
lines.zh: 不過重點是，這傢伙沒有說謊。

lines.en: I have a friend uh who stayed at his house for about a week and I asked him like the first thing I asked him is his daily routine like for real and it's for real. like they were having dinner at like 5 5:30 and then he was like after dinner he was like okay I'm gonna go sleep and my my friend was like what and he really wakes up at 2:30 like 2:33 and then works out like like a few hours before anyone even wakes up.
lines.zh: 我有個朋友在他家住了大約一個禮拜，我問他的第一件事就是他的作息是不是真的，結果是真的。他們大概 5 點、5 點半吃晚餐，吃完他就說：「好，我要去睡了。」我朋友就想：「什麼？」他真的 2:30、2:33 起床，在所有人醒來前先健身好幾個小時。

lines.en: So he's he is this disciplined but but it's still a wild crazy extreme version of a daily schedule that we don't need to do.
lines.zh: 所以他真的這麼自律，但這仍然是一個超狂、超極端的每日行程，我們沒必要照做。

lines.en: Like I I I think this would actually be worse for your health, especially if you're snacking 2.5 hours out of the day.
lines.zh: 我、我、我覺得這其實對健康更不好，尤其如果你一天花兩個半小時吃點心。

lines.en: So, here's another famous uh morning routine or daily routine, daily schedule, and it's uh it's actually by Benjamin Franklin.
lines.zh: 這裡還有另一個有名的晨間作息、每日行程，是班傑明富蘭克林的。

lines.en: Apparently, he printed this in a book.
lines.zh: 據說他把這個印在一本書裡。

lines.en: Okay, I'm surprised this exists like cuz morning routines and daily routines, it seems like something like you would do like in 2020s, right?
lines.zh: 好，我很驚訝這東西存在，因為晨間作息、每日作息，感覺像是 2020 年代才會做的事，對吧？

lines.en: Like something you would post to your socials, but he posted it.
lines.zh: 像是會發在社群上的東西，但他發了。

lines.en: Well, that that was the social media of their time, a book.
lines.zh: 嗯，在他那個時代，書就是社群媒體。

lines.en: So, here's what it says.
lines.zh: 它寫的是這樣。

lines.en: The morning question, what good shall I do this day?
lines.zh: 早晨的提問：我今天要做什麼好事？

lines.en: Okay, let me come back to that.
lines.zh: 好，我等一下再回來講這個。

lines.en: That's a That's actually a really good way to um make a schedule. 5:00 a.m. Rise, wash, and address.
lines.zh: 這其實是安排行程很好的方式。早上 5:00：起床、洗漱、向全能的良善祈禱。

lines.en: What the does that say?
lines.zh: 那到底寫什麼？

lines.en: Rise, wash, and address powerful goddess.
lines.zh: 起床、洗漱、向全能的女神祈禱。

lines.en: I legit thought it it said powerful goddess, but it's a powerful goodness.
lines.zh: 我真心以為寫的是「全能的女神」，結果是「全能的良善」。

lines.en: Contrive day's business and take the resolution of this day.
lines.zh: 籌劃當天的事務、下定當天的決心。

lines.en: Uh prosecute the present study and breakfast.
lines.zh: 呃，進行目前的學習，然後吃早餐。

lines.en: So basically what he's saying is uh wake up, wash, and then like plan out what he's going to do and then uh eat breakfast.
lines.zh: 所以他基本上是說：起床、洗漱，規劃要做什麼，然後吃早餐。

lines.en: But makes it sound so important, right? address powerful goodness.
lines.zh: 但講得好像很重要，對吧？向全能的良善祈禱。

lines.en: Contrive today's business just means uh what am I supposed to do today and take the resolution of the day like what am I I'm going to crush it today prosecute the present study just do what I do and then uh eat breakfast and then from 8 to 11 or 12 he works and then 12 to 1 read or uh overlook my accounts and dine.
lines.zh: 「籌劃當天的事務」就是「我今天要做什麼」；「下定當天的決心」就是「我今天要大殺四方」；「進行目前的學習」就是做我該做的事；然後吃早餐。接著 8 點到 11、12 點工作，12 點到 1 點閱讀或查看帳目，然後用餐。

lines.en: Okay. If any of you have like a daily schedule on your wall or like on your uh phone, change the wording because look at this.
lines.zh: 好，如果你們牆上或手機上有每日行程，改一下措辭，因為你看這個。

lines.en: Read or overlook my accounts and dine. This is okay.
lines.zh: 「閱讀或查看我的帳目，然後用餐。」這個好。

lines.en: In 2026 terms, this is just u yo check how much money I've lost.
lines.zh: 用 2026 年的說法，就是：欸，看看我賠了多少錢。

lines.en: Yo, check my bank account and eat. That's it. Right.
lines.zh: 欸，查一下銀行帳戶，然後吃飯。就這樣，對吧？

lines.en: But the way he words it, read or overlook my accounts and dine.
lines.zh: 但他的措辭是「閱讀或查看我的帳目，然後用餐」。

lines.en: I'm changing everything to dine. Okay.
lines.zh: 我要把所有「吃飯」都改成「用餐」。好。

lines.en: And then two to six work. Six to nine.
lines.zh: 然後 2 點到 6 點工作，6 點到 9 點……

lines.en: Put things in their places.
lines.zh: 「把東西歸回原位。」

lines.en: This guy man to the max. Performative.
lines.zh: 這傢伙把表演做到極致。

lines.en: Put things in their places.
lines.zh: 「把東西歸回原位。」

lines.en: Basically clean room. supper, music or diversion. Diversion is their times way of saying doom scroll or conversation texting examination of the day which translates into the am I doing today?
lines.zh: 基本上就是打掃房間。晚餐、音樂或消遣。「消遣」就是他們那個時代說的滑手機，或是聊天、傳訊息；「反省這一天」翻成白話就是「我今天到底在幹嘛？」

lines.en: And then uh from 10:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. sleep.
lines.zh: 然後晚上 10:00 到早上 5:00 睡覺。

lines.en: Oh, he has an evening question too on the side.
lines.zh: 喔，他旁邊還有一個晚上的提問。

lines.en: What good have I done today? Okay.
lines.zh: 「我今天做了什麼好事？」好。

lines.en: I like this thing on the side.
lines.zh: 我喜歡旁邊這個東西。

lines.en: Uh in the morning asking himself, "What good shall I do this day?"
lines.zh: 呃，早上問自己：「我今天要做什麼好事？」

lines.en: And then at night, "What good have I done today?"
lines.zh: 然後晚上問：「我今天做了什麼好事？」

lines.en: I actually have something on my schedule on my wall.
lines.zh: 我牆上的行程表其實也有類似的東西。

lines.en: It says, um, "Do something today that requires little of you and means a lot or the world to someone else. just one thing.
lines.zh: 上面寫著：「今天做一件對你來說不費力、對別人卻意義重大的事，只要一件就好。」

lines.en: It might be something as simple as um like if someone on Hey Tablo or Epik High is like, "Hey, I would love a a reply to my comment and then I just reply."
lines.zh: 可能只是很簡單的事，像是有人在 Hey Tablo 或 Epik High 的頻道說：「嘿，希望你能回我的留言。」然後我就回了。

lines.en: That might mean a lot to them.
lines.zh: 那對他們來說可能意義重大。

lines.en: It just, you know, takes up a couple minutes out of my day.
lines.zh: 那只佔用我一天中的幾分鐘。

lines.en: So something simple as that or, you know, doing something much more meaningful.
lines.zh: 可以是那麼簡單的事，也可以是更有意義的事。

lines.en: But all of it is if it requires less of me uh than it means to the person that is receiving it, I I think that's a good day.
lines.zh: 只要它對我的付出，比對收到的人的意義還少，我就覺得那是美好的一天。

lines.en: So I always write that on top of my schedule and and then I I have this one huge thing in like all caps.
lines.zh: 所以我總是把這句寫在行程表最上面，然後還有一句全部大寫的超大字。

lines.en: Today is going to be awesome. Okay.
lines.zh: 「今天會很棒。」好。

lines.en: So um so one lesson we can take from this uh Benjamin Franklin schedule is wording matters.
lines.zh: 所以從富蘭克林的行程表可以學到一課：措辭很重要。

lines.en: Instead of saying eat, write dine.
lines.zh: 不要寫「吃飯」，寫「用餐」。

lines.en: Instead of saying dinner, write supper.
lines.zh: 不要寫「晚餐」，寫「晚膳」。

lines.en: Instead of cleaning my room, put say put things in their places.
lines.zh: 不要寫「打掃房間」，寫「把東西歸回原位」。

lines.en: Uh instead of uh just scroll on my phone, waste my life or something. Uh write diversion.
lines.zh: 不要寫「滑手機、浪費人生」之類的，寫「消遣」。

lines.en: It just makes everything better.
lines.zh: 一切就變得更好了。

lines.en: But if you look at his day, it's not like he's doing anything like these famous people are doing anything like significantly more important or profound than than we do.
lines.zh: 但你看他的一天，這些名人做的事並沒有比我們重要或深刻多少。

lines.en: It's just the wording and the fact that he printed it on a book like on a page.
lines.zh: 只是措辭，還有他把它印在書上而已。

lines.en: Okay, let's look at another one.
lines.zh: 好，再看另一個。

lines.en: This is Haruki Murakami's daily routine.
lines.zh: 這是村上春樹的每日作息。

lines.en: Do you guys all know who that is? that's a he's a very famous novelist and um I've read about five of his books I think uh and he's known to be extremely extremely disciplined.
lines.zh: 大家都知道他是誰吧？他是非常有名的小說家，我大概讀過他五本書，他以極度、極度自律聞名。

lines.en: So a lot of people try his morning routine or his daily routine just to see like if it betters their uh li lives and um unfortunately the results are always terrible.
lines.zh: 所以很多人會試他的晨間作息或每日作息，看看能不能讓生活變好，但很遺憾，結果總是很慘。

lines.en: Like look at this one.
lines.zh: 像看看這個。

lines.en: I've been trying Haruki Murakami's routine.
lines.zh: 「我一直在試村上春樹的作息。」

lines.en: Wake up at 4:00 a.m. to get six hours of deep work.
lines.zh: 「早上 4 點起床，做六小時的深度工作。」

lines.en: And usually the conclusion is I can't do this.
lines.zh: 通常結論都是：我做不到。

lines.en: Let's look at the uh routine.
lines.zh: 我們來看看這個作息。

lines.en: So he wakes up at 4 4:00 a.m. and then uh immediately does task which is writing basically 4 to noon.
lines.zh: 他早上 4 點起床，然後立刻開始工作，基本上就是寫作，從 4 點寫到中午。

lines.en: So, eight hours. He's he's like he's like sleeping like he probably sleeps next to the desk like this and then because that's what it says.
lines.zh: 所以是八個小時。他、他、他大概就睡在書桌旁邊，因為上面就是這樣寫的。

lines.en: It doesn't even say wake up.
lines.zh: 上面連「起床」都沒寫。

lines.en: It's just he was sleeping until 4 and then from 4 he's doing the task writing.
lines.zh: 就是他睡到 4 點，然後從 4 點開始寫作。

lines.en: He's just for 8 hours doesn't go to the bathroom. doesn't drink water, doesn't say hi to anybody.
lines.zh: 他就這樣八個小時，不上廁所、不喝水、不跟任何人打招呼。

lines.en: He's just until noon and immediately he's got his like running shoes on and he's outside running 10 kilometers.
lines.zh: 一直到中午，然後馬上穿上跑鞋，出門跑十公里。

lines.en: Or sometimes he'll do a,500 meter uh swim session or both.
lines.zh: 或者有時候會游 1,500 公尺，或兩個都做。

lines.en: It says or both from 12 to two.
lines.zh: 上面寫「或兩個都做」，從 12 點到 2 點。

lines.en: So for two hours after like eight hours of just crushing it on the keyboards, he goes out there and just runs and swims for 2 hours.
lines.zh: 所以在鍵盤上火力全開八小時後，他又出去跑步游泳兩小時。

lines.en: And then from 2 to 9:00 p.m. it says rest.
lines.zh: 然後從 2 點到晚上 9 點，寫著「休息」。

lines.en: Uh it says rest, reading or listening to music for 7 hours.
lines.zh: 呃，寫著休息、閱讀或聽音樂七小時。

lines.en: And then he goes to sleep at 9:00 and then wakes up again at 4:00 and then immediately Okay,
lines.zh: 然後 9 點睡覺，4 點又起床，然後立刻……好，

lines.en: this is the strangest daily routine I have ever seen in my life because it's it's like uh most uh schedules are like, you know, like in and out, right?
lines.zh: 這是我這輩子看過最奇怪的每日作息，因為大部分行程都是穿插著來的，對吧？

lines.en: Like, you know, you'll have a snack and then you'll like shower and then work a little bit and then work out and then work again a little bit,
lines.zh: 像是你會吃個點心、洗個澡、工作一下、運動、再工作一下，

lines.en: rest, spend time with family and then work a little bit more and then shower and then sleep or something, right?
lines.zh: 休息、陪家人、再多工作一點，然後洗澡、睡覺之類的，對吧？

lines.en: But this guy is just like in huge blocks. wakes up and does his, you know, does his thing, his profession, which happens to be writing.
lines.zh: 但這傢伙是一大塊一大塊的。起床，做他的事、他的專業，剛好是寫作。

lines.en: So, he's he just write storms.
lines.zh: 所以他就是瘋狂地寫。

lines.en: He just word storms for about eight hours and then two hours of uh like hardcore exercise and then just totally rests and then goes to sleep.
lines.zh: 他就是狂寫大約八小時，然後兩小時高強度運動，接著完全休息，然後睡覺。

lines.en: So, there's only like four sections of his day.
lines.zh: 所以他的一天只有四個區塊。

lines.en: His profession, exercise, leisure, and then sleep.
lines.zh: 專業、運動、休閒，然後睡覺。

lines.en: It's actually pretty doable and cool and strangely enough very very similar to my daily routine.
lines.zh: 這其實滿可行的，也很酷，而且奇怪的是，跟我的每日作息非常非常像。

lines.en: I'll explain later, but this is not that far from my routine.
lines.zh: 我之後會解釋，但這跟我的作息沒差多少。

lines.en: This isn't exactly a daily routine or a schedule, but a part of your daily schedule, you know, should include workouts, right?
lines.zh: 這不完全是每日作息或行程，但你的每日行程應該要包含運動，對吧？

lines.en: It's the One Punch Man workout.
lines.zh: 這是《一拳超人》的訓練菜單。

lines.en: You know, it's Saitama from the anime One Punch Man. So, it's it's simple.
lines.zh: 你知道，就是動畫《一拳超人》裡的埼玉。很簡單。

lines.en: It's uh 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, and 10 kilometer run every single day.
lines.zh: 就是每天 100 下伏地挺身、100 下仰臥起坐、100 下深蹲，還有跑十公里。

lines.en: It's actually pretty doable, isn't it? That's all he does.
lines.zh: 其實滿可行的，不是嗎？他就只做這些。

lines.en: And Murakami Haruki is probably stronger than One Punch Man because he's like not only is he running, you know, like 10 kilometers.
lines.zh: 而且村上春樹大概比一拳超人還強，因為他不只跑十公里。

lines.en: He's He wakes up and he's just like, you know how strong your forearms need to be to be able to type for 8 hours? Just Okay.
lines.zh: 他一起床就……你知道要打字八小時，前臂得多強壯嗎？好吧。

lines.en: So, this is the day in the life of Steve Jobs, the man who gave us this this phone.
lines.zh: 這是賈伯斯的一天，就是給我們這支手機的人。

lines.en: This very device that has destroyed our daily routines and our morning routines and our daily schedules.
lines.zh: 就是這支毀了我們每日作息、晨間作息和每日行程的裝置。

lines.en: Let's look at his uh daily routine. 6:00 a.m. wake up.
lines.zh: 來看看他的每日作息。早上 6:00 起床。

lines.en: I'm a good morning person.
lines.zh: 「我是早起的人。」

lines.en: I like it early in the morning. I wake up 6ish.
lines.zh: 「我喜歡一大早，我大概 6 點起床。」

lines.en: Uh, one thing you'll notice, the schedules or daily routines of like quote unquote successful people, they always start their day really early.
lines.zh: 呃，你會注意到一件事：所謂「成功人士」的行程或作息，總是很早就開始一天。

lines.en: They all like wake up at least before 8 is what I've noticed. Uh, 6:30 a.m.
lines.zh: 我注意到他們至少都在 8 點前起床。呃，6:30，

lines.en: He works. 7:30 a.m. breakfast with family. 9:00 a.m. arrive at the office. 9:30 a.m. meetings.
lines.zh: 他工作。7:30 和家人吃早餐。9:00 到辦公室。9:30 開會。

lines.en: Noon lunch. 1:30 p.m. visit design lab.
lines.zh: 中午吃午餐。下午 1:30 去設計實驗室。

lines.en: Yeah, Steve Jobs was um he was very hands-on with everything that was going on at Apple, but most of all uh the design lab because he wanted to look at how uh the future products actually felt like in the hand, right?
lines.zh: 對，賈伯斯對蘋果的所有事都非常親力親為，但最重要的是設計實驗室，因為他想看未來的產品拿在手上是什麼感覺，對吧？

lines.en: And uh not many CEOs did that, especially the CEOs before him uh at Apple never cared about the design people.
lines.zh: 呃，沒有多少執行長會這樣做，尤其是他之前的蘋果執行長從來不在乎設計人員。

lines.en: And I, you know, obviously it worked out, right?
lines.zh: 而結果顯然很成功，對吧？

lines.en: So 3:00 p.m. emails, meetings, and phone calls. 5:30 p.m. Family dinner. 6:30 p.m. Walk with Loren.
lines.zh: 所以下午 3:00 處理郵件、開會、打電話。5:30 家庭晚餐。6:30 和蘿琳散步。

lines.en: Uh 10 p.m. music, meditation, and spirituality.
lines.zh: 呃，晚上 10 點音樂、冥想和心靈時間。

lines.en: I guess this is sort of Murakami Haruki's like um you know, like listening to music and resting time, right? So windown time.
lines.zh: 我想這有點像村上春樹聽音樂、休息的時間，對吧？就是放鬆收心的時間。

lines.en: So he sleeps at 10:00, wakes up at 6:00. That's exactly eight hours. H okay.
lines.zh: 所以他 10 點睡、6 點起，剛好八小時。嗯，好。

lines.en: So he got good sleep at least.
lines.zh: 所以他至少睡得很好。

lines.en: You know, the uh eight hours sleep thing is so hard for me.
lines.zh: 你知道，睡滿八小時對我來說好難。

lines.en: Uh no matter how long I sleep, it's it's seven hours.
lines.zh: 呃，不管我睡多久，都是七小時。

lines.en: I can't for some odd reason like even if I don't have to do anything in the morning like and I try, I cannot sleep more than seven hours.
lines.zh: 不知道為什麼，就算早上沒事、就算我努力試，我也睡不超過七小時。

lines.en: Maybe that's my uh bio rhythm.
lines.zh: 也許那是我的生理節奏。

lines.en: But you know, they say 8 hours is like what you need to, you know, stay alive like into your hundreds.
lines.zh: 但你知道，大家說要睡八小時才能活到一百多歲。

lines.en: I guess, you know, it's not happening for me, sadly. Uh, okay.
lines.zh: 我想我大概沒辦法了，很可惜。呃，好。

lines.en: This is a pretty normal schedule, right? But here's the thing.
lines.zh: 這是很正常的行程，對吧？但重點是。

lines.en: There are so many articles like, I copied Steve Jobs morning routine for a week from diet to outfit. Here's how it went. Okay.
lines.zh: 有好多文章像是：「我照抄賈伯斯的晨間作息一週，從飲食到穿著，結果如何？」好。

lines.en: The fact that there are so many people trying just, you know, just flat out exactly mimicking a famous person or a successful person's daily schedule is it's not going to work is what I want to say.
lines.zh: 我想說的是，這麼多人直接一模一樣地模仿名人或成功人士的每日行程，是不會成功的。

lines.en: Like just don't do it.
lines.zh: 就是別這樣做。

lines.en: You know, you know that book um the the seven habits of successful whatever people, you all know that book, right?
lines.zh: 你知道那本書，《與成功有約：高效能人士的七個習慣》，大家都知道吧？

lines.en: When I was a kid, my dad was like, "You got to read this book."
lines.zh: 我小時候，我爸說：「你一定要讀這本書。」

lines.en: And I was like, why?
lines.zh: 我就想：為什麼？

lines.en: Um, look at the cover.
lines.zh: 呃，看看封面。

lines.en: And I'm like, oh, okay.
lines.zh: 我就想：喔，好。

lines.en: To be successful, these are the habits you need to have, right?
lines.zh: 要成功，就得有這些習慣，對吧？

lines.en: And I read it and the, you know, even as a kid, uh, reading that book, I was like, okay, so if just doing exactly what these people did and just having, uh, the same habits makes you successful,
lines.zh: 我讀了，而且就算還是小孩，讀那本書時我也想：好，如果只要照這些人做的去做、擁有相同的習慣就能成功，

lines.en: anybody that buys this book can be successful. that it just makes no sense because you know circumstances are different you know the environment is different everything everything is you know different so you know just just mimicking someone's lifestyle it might make you you know seem successful but it's not catered to the way you are right everybody has different bio rhythm everybody has a different wave and everybody you know just has different times that they're they're they're efficient at,
lines.zh: 那任何買這本書的人都能成功了。這根本說不通，因為每個人的情況不同、環境不同、一切都不同，所以只模仿別人的生活方式，也許看起來很成功，但那不是為你量身打造的，對吧？每個人的生理節奏不同、步調不同，每個人效率最好的時段也不同，

lines.en: right? So, just following or just mimicking somebody's daily routine is not going to make you Steve Jobs, which usually is the conclusion of these articles.
lines.zh: 對吧？所以只是照著或模仿別人的作息，並不會讓你變成賈伯斯，這通常也是這些文章的結論。

lines.en: They're like, "Let's look at the conclusion."
lines.zh: 他們會說：「我們來看結論。」

lines.en: So, this person like literally copied like the outfit and everything.
lines.zh: 這個人真的連穿著什麼的都照抄了。

lines.en: And look, 6:30 a.m. morning incantation, 7:30 a.m. fruity breakfast, 8:00 a.m. back to work, 9:30 a.m. arrive at the office. and then ends the day. Okay.
lines.zh: 你看，早上 6:30 晨間咒語，7:30 水果早餐，8:00 回去工作，9:30 到辦公室，然後結束一天。好。

lines.en: Okay. So, this person comes to the same conclusion as what I just said.
lines.zh: 好。所以這個人得出的結論和我剛說的一樣。

lines.en: This experience proved to me that having a routine is great, but finding one that actually works for you is most important. Yes.
lines.zh: 「這次經驗讓我明白，有固定作息很棒，但找到真正適合自己的才最重要。」對。

lines.en: So, all the uh daily routines that we look at today, don't just do it because it sounds cool.
lines.zh: 所以今天看的這些每日作息，不要只因為聽起來很酷就照做。

lines.en: It may actually kill you.
lines.zh: 它可能真的會要你的命。

lines.en: Especially the uh Mark Wahlberg one.
lines.zh: 尤其是馬克華伯格那個。

lines.en: If I wake up at 2:30 a.m. and then like I'm, you know, exercising for like three hours before anyone wakes up, I'll be dead by the time they wake up.
lines.zh: 如果我凌晨 2:30 起床，然後在所有人醒來前運動三個小時，等他們醒來我已經掛了。

lines.en: Can you guys think of a celebrity or a known person who is famous for being lazy?
lines.zh: 你們能想到哪個以懶惰出名的名人嗎？

lines.en: Because we need to uh look at a different type of daily routine.
lines.zh: 因為我們需要看看不一樣的每日作息。

lines.en: All these people are waking up way too early and too efficient. They're like machines.
lines.zh: 這些人都起得太早、效率太高了，像機器一樣。

lines.en: We need like a normal like just, you know, of a of a 25 year old guy. Winston Churchill stayed in bed until 11:00 a.m. eating breakfast. Oh, yeah.
lines.zh: 我們需要一個正常的，像是一個 25 歲男生的。邱吉爾會待在床上吃早餐到早上 11 點。喔，對。

lines.en: It's in that movie, too.
lines.zh: 那部電影裡也有演。

lines.en: So, um there's this uh daily routine called Winston Churchill's Epic Daily Routine.
lines.zh: 所以有一個每日作息叫「邱吉爾的傳奇每日作息」。

lines.en: Let's look at why it's uh epic. 7:30 a.m.
lines.zh: 來看看它為什麼傳奇。早上 7:30。

lines.en: Wake up, remain in bed, eat breakfast, read newspapers, work, glass of whiskey and soda.
lines.zh: 起床、待在床上、吃早餐、看報紙、工作、一杯威士忌加蘇打。

lines.en: Okay, this is a pretty wild way to start your day.
lines.zh: 好，這是很狂的一天開始方式。

lines.en: Glass of whiskey and soda in bed.
lines.zh: 在床上喝一杯威士忌加蘇打。

lines.en: Have you seen the uh movie Churchill with the uh with um Gary Oldman as Churchill, a great actor, but um if you see that movie, you actually get to see his daily routine.
lines.zh: 你們有看過蓋瑞歐德曼演邱吉爾的那部電影嗎？他是很棒的演員，如果你看那部電影，其實就能看到他的每日作息。

lines.en: Like he he's literally in bed uh with breakfast in bed and he has someone he always has someone taking dictation.
lines.zh: 他真的就在床上吃早餐，而且身邊總有一個人在幫他聽寫。

lines.en: So, he's just, you know, spitting out a speech and the person that he's hired just writes everything and he's just in bed like just throwing it out.
lines.zh: 所以他就是口述演講稿，他請的人把一切都寫下來，他就待在床上一直講。

lines.en: That's why it's possible.
lines.zh: 所以才做得到。

lines.en: But I did not know that he was drinking whiskey at 7:30 a.m. 11:00 a.m. he gets out of bed, strolls around the garden supervising the estate.
lines.zh: 但我不知道他早上 7:30 就在喝威士忌。11 點他起床，在花園裡散步、巡視莊園。

lines.en: Okay, supervising the estate means just roaming around.
lines.zh: 好，「巡視莊園」就是四處晃晃。

lines.en: It's like if you if you wake up and you're just like walking around your living room or like you just go out and you're just like walking around the front of your building.
lines.zh: 就像你起床後在客廳走來走去，或是出門在大樓前面走來走去。

lines.en: That's what you know that's what supervising estate means.
lines.zh: 那就是「巡視莊園」的意思。

lines.en: And then whiskey and soda. Okay.
lines.zh: 然後又是威士忌加蘇打。好。

lines.en: That's two that's that's two rounds of whiskey and soda. 1:00 p.m. multicourse lunch. Imperial pint of champagne. Okay.
lines.zh: 那是兩杯、兩杯威士忌加蘇打了。下午 1:00 多道菜的午餐，配一品脫香檳。好。

lines.en: This guy's just an alcoholic. 3:30 p.m.
lines.zh: 這傢伙根本是酒鬼。下午 3:30，

lines.en: Work from study, glass of cognac.
lines.zh: 在書房工作，配一杯干邑白蘭地。

lines.en: Is this for real? 5:00 p.m. hour and a half nap.
lines.zh: 這是真的嗎？下午 5:00 午睡一個半小時。

lines.en: A habit acquired during his time in Cuba.
lines.zh: 這是他在古巴時養成的習慣。

lines.en: Okay. 6:30, wake up, bath, dress for dinner. 8:00 p.m. lengthy uh dinner with guests with an imperial pint of champagne.
lines.zh: 好。6:30 起床、洗澡、換裝準備晚餐。8:00 和賓客吃很久的晚餐，配一品脫香檳。

lines.en: Midnight work in the study and more cognac and 1 a.m. he just passes the out.
lines.zh: 半夜在書房工作、喝更多干邑，然後凌晨 1 點直接醉倒。

lines.en: He's like where where am I? Okay.
lines.zh: 他會想：我在哪裡？好。

lines.en: And apparently only sleeps from 1:00 a.m.
lines.zh: 據說他只從凌晨 1 點開始睡。

lines.en: So six six hours around six to 6.5 hours. Wow.
lines.zh: 所以大概六、六個半小時。哇。

lines.en: Didn't he like live to a very old age?
lines.zh: 他不是活到很老嗎？

lines.en: It's pretty healthy I think. Um, yeah, this is a pretty crazy daily routine.
lines.zh: 我覺得滿健康的吧。嗯，對，這是很瘋狂的每日作息。

lines.en: I'm not sure if this is for real, but I would not be surprised. Okay.
lines.zh: 我不確定這是不是真的，但就算是我也不意外。好。

lines.en: Uh apparently she's got a very like disciplined uh routine where she wakes up pretty early and then like works out.
lines.zh: 呃，據說她的作息非常自律，很早起床然後運動。

lines.en: Like no matter how busy she is or even if she just did like a like an ad ad shoot like the night before and ended late or had a show or a concert,
lines.zh: 不管多忙，就算前一晚拍廣告拍到很晚，或是有表演、演唱會，

lines.en: she'll like wake up early and still exercise. and she does all of these things where like she eats something and then like you know there certain like health foods and stuff and she's extremely disciplined is is what people say and I I can't find the schedule but what I've noticed is that K-pop idols they they live a very different life like even some of the friends that I have who have been in the K-pop world for a while right and don't have to train as hard as they used too.
lines.zh: 她還是會早起運動。她會做很多這類的事，像是吃某些健康食品之類的，大家都說她極度自律。我找不到她的行程表，但我注意到 K-pop 偶像過著非常不一樣的生活，就算是我一些在 K-pop 圈待很久、不用像以前那麼拚命練習的朋友，

lines.en: Um even they practice I think like f at least five hours every day like just just for dance.
lines.zh: 呃，他們還是每天至少練五個小時，光是跳舞就這樣。

lines.en: Uh and then they'll take like vocal lessons.
lines.zh: 呃，然後還要上聲樂課。

lines.en: Um sometimes like they'll have to wake up very early to do those music shows.
lines.zh: 嗯，有時候為了上音樂節目得很早起。

lines.en: For music shows, you know, like you have to be there by like 6 or 7 a.m. which means that you have to be at the uh hair place and like makeup place.
lines.zh: 音樂節目，你知道，大概要 6、7 點就到場，代表你得先去髮型、化妝的地方。

lines.en: Uh, and if you have like multiple members, you also have to wait for everyone else, right?
lines.zh: 呃，如果團員很多，你還得等其他人，對吧？

lines.en: So, you're probably there at like 3 4 a.m. getting ready and then you go and, you know, do rehearsals and then you wait like four hours.
lines.zh: 所以你大概凌晨 3、4 點就在那裡準備，然後去彩排，再等四個小時。

lines.en: You do another like set of rehearsals and then you do the show and then you have to in between you got to like go somewhere else to do an interview shoot like challenges and then somewhere in all of that you have you have to also exercise and like do dance practices and stuff like this and it's it's definitely not easy.
lines.zh: 再彩排一次，然後上節目，中間還得跑去別的地方拍訪問、拍挑戰影片，這些中間還得運動、練舞之類的，真的一點都不輕鬆。

lines.en: Uh, speaking of K-pop, let's uh look at the daily routines of some famous K-pop adjacent celebrities that I actually know.
lines.zh: 呃，說到 K-pop，我們來看看幾位和 K-pop 沾上邊、而且我真的認識的名人的每日作息。

lines.en: This is Epik High Mithra's daily schedule. Mithra, 7:45 a.m.
lines.zh: 這是 Epik High 的 Mithra 的每日行程。Mithra，早上 7:45，

lines.en: Wake up. 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m.
Take a son to school. 11:00 a.m. 11:30 a.m.
Brunch 2:30 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Boxing. What?
lines.zh: 早午餐。下午 2:30 到 4:00 打拳擊。什麼？

lines.en: This is just just seems like a lie.
lines.zh: 這根本像是騙人的。

lines.en: Boxing for an hour and a half. Since when?
lines.zh: 打拳擊一個半小時？什麼時候開始的？

lines.en: I I I guarantee you he went like twice. So, okay.
lines.zh: 我、我、我保證他大概只去過兩次。好。

lines.en: So, until 4 p.m. boxing. 4:30 p.m. uh Eden comes home.
lines.zh: 所以打拳擊到下午 4 點。4:30 Eden 回家。

lines.en: But Eden ends really late.
lines.zh: 但 Eden 下課好晚。

lines.en: How is his school ending an hour later than Haru's?
lines.zh: 他的學校怎麼比 Haru 還晚一個小時放學？

lines.en: Haru is in high school.
lines.zh: Haru 已經是高中生了。

lines.en: What the is he putting Eden through?
lines.zh: 他到底讓 Eden 經歷了什麼？

lines.en: What kind of school are you going to Eden? Okay.
lines.zh: Eden，你到底讀的是什麼學校？好。

lines.en: Uh 6:30 p.m. dinner. 8:30 p.m.
Uh Eden takes a bath. And then 9:00 p.m. Yuk is what?
lines.zh: 呃，Eden 洗澡。然後晚上 9:00 育兒結束，這是什麼？

lines.en: Oh, done with taking care of the kid.
lines.zh: 喔，照顧小孩的工作結束。

lines.en: And then 9:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. freedom. It just says freedom. And then midnight sleep.
lines.zh: 然後晚上 9:00 到 11:00 自由。就寫「自由」。然後午夜睡覺。

lines.en: Because he's a dad and he, you know, he has a really, really small child.
lines.zh: 因為他是爸爸，孩子還非常非常小。

lines.en: His daily routine is basically his kids' routine.
lines.zh: 他的每日作息基本上就是孩子的作息。

lines.en: If your kid is like maybe, you know, five, six, um, it's whatever they need becomes your daily routine. So this is understandable.
lines.zh: 如果你的孩子大概五、六歲，他們需要什麼，就會變成你的每日作息。所以可以理解。

lines.en: And let me tell you, like the reason why he wrote freedom, I get it.
lines.zh: 而且我跟你說，他為什麼寫「自由」，我懂。

lines.en: Like that feeling when the kid goes to sleep and you're allowed to just do whatever and just not do anything productive and you end up like just doom scrolling and and just or just lying there.
lines.zh: 就是那種孩子睡著後，你可以隨便做什麼、完全不用有生產力的感覺，結果你就一直滑手機，或只是躺在那裡。

lines.en: Are any of you surprised that he wakes up so early?
lines.zh: 他這麼早起，你們有人驚訝嗎？

lines.en: This is just what dads do.
lines.zh: 爸爸就是這樣。

lines.en: Like there's you have no choice.
lines.zh: 你別無選擇。

lines.en: I'm I'm fairly certain he's lying about the boxing thing.
lines.zh: 我、我非常確定他打拳擊那件事是騙人的。

lines.en: And he didn't write like when he goes to the bathroom and scrolls on his phone, right?
lines.zh: 而且他沒寫他什麼時候去廁所滑手機，對吧？

lines.en: So, he probably does like four bathroom sessions where he's just in there for like 30 minutes looking at his phone.
lines.zh: 所以他大概去四次廁所，每次在裡面待 30 分鐘看手機。

lines.en: Um, so that's that's this is not an honest daily routine.
lines.zh: 嗯，所以這不是誠實的每日作息。

lines.zh: 我陪 Haru 或 Hyejung，對吧？

lines.en: So we just watch something together.
lines.zh: 我們就一起看點東西。

lines.en: And then from 10 p.m. to 11 p.m.
lines.zh: 然後晚上 10 點到 11 點，

lines.en: I wind down and sleep. That's my daily routine.
lines.zh: 我放鬆，然後睡覺。這就是我的每日作息。

lines.en: So if you think about it, it's not that different from Murakami Haruki's because I wake up early.
lines.zh: 所以仔細想想，跟村上春樹的差不多，因為我很早起。

lines.en: I, you know, just do what I got what I got to do and then from 3:00 p.m.
lines.zh: 我把該做的事做完，然後從下午 3:00 開始，

lines.en: I'm technically just, you know, in leisure mode.
lines.zh: 技術上我就進入休閒模式了。

lines.en: It's not really leisure because I'm parenting, right?
lines.zh: 其實不算休閒，因為我在當爸爸，對吧？

lines.en: And also I love the fact that my work has become sort of mobile and I don't like there are certain elements of that that I don't like but after co you know how we all like kind of went more mobile more digital it actually works for me because I get to be with my family I get to be home and still like you know still still do everything,
lines.zh: 而且我很喜歡我的工作變得比較行動化，雖然有些部分我不喜歡，但疫情之後大家都變得更行動、更數位，這其實很適合我，因為我可以陪家人、待在家，還是能把所有事做完，

lines.en: you know. You know, now we have this uh fan community where we have like the texting service, right?
lines.zh: 你知道。你知道我們現在有一個粉絲社群，有傳訊息的服務，對吧？

lines.en: So, I'm also texting them a lot on top of the text I send you and the text I I you know that go back and forth with Haru, with Hyejung, with Mithra and Tukutz.
lines.zh: 所以除了傳給你的訊息，還有我和 Haru、Hyejung、Mithra、Tukutz 來來回回的訊息之外，我也傳很多訊息給粉絲。

lines.en: I'm texting my fans a lot now.
lines.zh: 我現在傳很多訊息給粉絲。

lines.en: Do you know that when we started that fan community, someone on on their side actually said, uh, you should really think hard about whether or not you want to,
lines.zh: 你知道我們開始經營那個粉絲社群時，對方有人說：呃，你真的要好好考慮要不要提供這個傳訊息的服務，

lines.en: you know, offer this texting service because, uh, you're busy and it requires, you know, some commitment, right?
lines.zh: 因為你很忙，而且這需要一定的投入，對吧？

lines.en: Like you can't like people are subscribing, so you can't you can't just like send four texts per month.
lines.zh: 因為大家是付費訂閱的，所以你不能一個月只傳四則。

lines.en: And I was like, I'm worried I'm going to send 15 per day. What do you mean?
lines.zh: 我就說：我比較擔心我會一天傳 15 則。你在說什麼？

lines.en: Like seriously, our fans are getting a bargain because you have no idea.
lines.zh: 說真的，我們的粉絲賺到了，因為你們不知道。

lines.en: I have to restrain myself from going in more and have to work hard to like text more than they usually do.
lines.zh: 我得克制自己不要傳更多，還得努力傳得比平常多。

lines.en: I have to restrain myself because like I said, deep focus.
lines.zh: 我得克制自己，因為就像我說的，深度專注。

lines.en: I'm able to text my fans at least like I I can honestly if there were no ethical limits.
lines.zh: 老實說，如果沒有道德上的限制，我至少可以……

lines.en: Okay, I swear to God I can I can text my fans maybe like 200 texts per day.
lines.zh: 好，我對天發誓，我一天大概可以傳 200 則訊息給粉絲。

lines.en: Okay, there were no ethical limits.
lines.zh: 好，如果沒有道德限制的話。

lines.en: Like the only reason why I can't do it is because I know a bunch of people will unsubscribe.
lines.zh: 我唯一沒這樣做的原因，是我知道一堆人會取消訂閱。

lines.en: And all those memes that I post, like not not the Epik High ones, but the memes like the the memes on my Instagram, I make those.
lines.zh: 還有我發的那些迷因，不是 Epik High 帳號的那些，而是我 Instagram 上的迷因，都是我自己做的。

lines.en: I don't have a team making them.
lines.zh: 我沒有團隊幫我做。

lines.en: I make them on my phone with I make all of the memes that I post.
lines.zh: 我用手機做，我發的所有迷因都是我自己做的。

lines.en: And I'm really good at Photoshop now.
lines.zh: 而且我現在 Photoshop 很厲害。

lines.en: Like I I can I can put Tukutz on anything, okay?
lines.zh: 我可以把 Tukutz 放到任何東西上，好嗎？

lines.en: And I make them hella fast.
lines.zh: 而且我做得超級快。

lines.en: And my fans should know this, okay?
lines.zh: 我的粉絲應該要知道這件事，好嗎？

lines.en: Because Tukutz sent a picture and I immediately turned it into a meme and sent it back.
lines.zh: 因為 Tukutz 傳了一張照片，我馬上把它做成迷因傳回去。

lines.en: And then Mithra sent a picture and I put the Tukutz meme into Mithra's picture and sent it back like super fast.
lines.zh: 然後 Mithra 傳了一張照片，我把 Tukutz 的迷因放進 Mithra 的照片，超快傳回去。

lines.en: I am just fast at it.
lines.zh: 我就是做得很快。

lines.en: I'm not not present is what I'm trying to say.
lines.zh: 我想說的是，我並不是心不在焉。

lines.en: I'm not a bad parent. I'm just doing all of this really fast. Okay.
lines.zh: 我不是不好的家長，我只是把這些都做得很快。好。

lines.en: And I I just have a lot to say, you know.
lines.zh: 而且我就是有很多話想說，你知道。

lines.en: I need to start I I actually had another thing on my daily uh routine that I haven't been keeping up with recently.
lines.zh: 我需要開始……其實我的每日作息還有另一件事，最近都沒做到。

lines.en: I actually took it out of my the thing on my wall.
lines.zh: 我其實把它從牆上的那張表拿掉了。

lines.en: Um it used to be write eight bars of rap, but just looked weird like being on there cuz everything else looks so cool.
lines.zh: 嗯，以前是「寫八小節饒舌」，但放在上面看起來很怪，因為其他項目看起來都很酷。

lines.en: It's like stretch. take vitamins, you know, like learn a foreign language, eight bars of rap.
lines.zh: 像是伸展、吃維他命、學外語，然後八小節饒舌。

lines.en: I still have, you know, this thing where like I have a memo where it's uh daily bars where I'll try to write like two, three lines just to, you know, make sure that I don't lose it.
lines.zh: 我還是有一個備忘錄叫「每日歌詞」，我會試著寫兩、三行，確保自己不會生疏。

lines.en: Do do you notice that I just spent the the majority of the time, like a bulk of the time just talking about my daily routine as if everything else. so far has been a buildup to this.
lines.zh: 你們有沒有發現我花了大部分時間、一大半時間在講我的每日作息，好像前面的一切都只是為了鋪陳這個。

lines.en: You know, I spent maybe like maybe like three minutes on Steve Jobs.
lines.zh: 你知道，我講賈伯斯大概只講了三分鐘。

lines.en: Winston Churchill was like two minutes.
lines.zh: 邱吉爾大概兩分鐘。

lines.en: I just talked for for like for like 15 20 minutes just on my, you know, just on this.
lines.zh: 我卻講了大概 15、20 分鐘，光是講我自己的。

lines.en: Anyways, uh to wrap up, daily routines are important. Structure is important.
lines.zh: 總之，呃，總結一下：每日作息很重要，架構很重要。

lines.en: Even if it's a daily schedule or a routine that you break all the time,
lines.zh: 就算是你老是打破的每日行程或作息，

lines.en: having something to break is important in my opinion because it at least reminds you that you're you're not keeping a promise with yourself. just just a little and it'll impel you to do it the day after or,
lines.zh: 我認為有個東西可以打破也很重要，因為它至少會提醒你，你沒有遵守對自己的承諾，一點點也好，它會推動你隔天，

lines.en: you know, two days later.
lines.zh: 或兩天後去做到。

lines.en: Even, you know, just getting coffee at your favorite coffee place is is a very good ritual to have.
lines.zh: 就算只是去你最喜歡的咖啡店買咖啡，也是一個很好的固定儀式。

lines.en: So, I do recommend having a daily schedule, but I do not recommend following any of the daily routines that I discussed today.
lines.zh: 所以我推薦要有每日行程，但我不推薦照做今天討論的任何一個每日作息。

lines.en: If any of them match uh your natural flow, then yes, mimic it.
lines.zh: 如果其中有符合你自然節奏的，那就模仿吧。

lines.en: But uh just just following some famous person's daily routine thinking that it'll it'll turn you into them is crazy. Okay.
lines.zh: 但呃，以為照著某個名人的每日作息做就能變成他們，是很瘋狂的想法。好。

lines.en: Just because you wake up at around the same time as a as a super rich person, you're not going to just suddenly be rich. Okay?
lines.zh: 不會因為你和一個超有錢的人差不多時間起床，就突然變有錢。好嗎？

lines.en: And uh just because you're waking up 4 hours later than somebody who's, you know,
lines.zh: 呃，也不會因為你比某個勤奮、成功的人晚四小時起床，

lines.en: diligent and successful doesn't mean you're not going to be successful. like you know you you there's tons of people that wake up at like 2 3 PM um after like staying up all night every day and they're still successful, right?
lines.zh: 就代表你不會成功。你知道，有很多人每天熬夜到天亮、下午兩三點才起床，還是很成功，對吧？

lines.en: So just do what suits you and above all do what makes your mind and body feel good, like feel healthy.
lines.zh: 所以做適合你的事，最重要的是做讓你身心感覺良好、感覺健康的事。

lines.en: And like I said, it's great to have a mantra.
lines.zh: 就像我說的，有一句座右銘很棒。

lines.en: It's great to have like a motto at the top of your schedule.
lines.zh: 在行程表最上面放一句格言很棒。

lines.en: I have actually like I have a prayer that I made.
lines.zh: 我其實有一段自己寫的禱詞。

lines.en: It's a meditation I guess.
lines.zh: 我想算是一種冥想。

lines.en: Do something that requires little of you but means the world to someone else and then your day is going to be awesome.
lines.zh: 做一件對你來說不費力、對別人卻意義重大的事，那你的一天就會很棒。

lines.en: Today's going to be awesome.
lines.zh: 今天會很棒。

lines.en: Just reading that and then doing my stretch is meditation for me.
lines.zh: 光是讀這句然後做伸展，對我來說就是冥想。

lines.en: Meditation doesn't have to be like, you know, you turn on some like weird sound and then you go like that doesn't have to be your your method.
lines.zh: 冥想不一定要放一些奇怪的聲音然後這樣，那不一定是你的方法。

lines.en: Like anything that makes you feel like yourself or a a better version of yourself can be meditation is what I'm saying. Okay.
lines.zh: 我是說，任何讓你感覺做回自己、或成為更好的自己的事，都可以是冥想。好。

lines.en: You know what the best thing to include on your daily routine is?
lines.zh: 你知道每日作息裡最該加的一件事是什麼嗎？

lines.en: Listening to Hey Tablo. Thank you. Hey Tablo.
lines.zh: 收聽 Hey Tablo。謝謝。Hey Tablo。
